## Family Stories

Doris was the sixth child of Francis Charles and Amy Telfer, part of the large family raised on the pioneering farm at Ungarra. She married Albert Rowe and together they raised a family that included sons John, Lindsay and Roy, and a daughter Joy Meredith. *(From the Borders to the Bush, p.175)*
